critical.finding: FY2025 operating income in the prefetch is wrong: pf_operating_income_fy2025 = -425,313k ('derived: pretax_income + interest_expense', facts._ebit_proxy) does not tie to the 10-K; statement of operations: total revenues 70,918k - total operating expenses 358,631k = -287,713k (reading/release_2026-03-02__asts-ex99_1.txt lines ~397-459 and the 10-K). Same defect in pf_operating_income_fy2024 (-506,302k vs -242,762k) and pf_operating_income_q_2026_06_30 (-275,206k vs -297,577k = 31,520k - 329,097k). The lane facts nm_operating_income_fy2025/fy2024/q_2026_06_30 carry the right values, so the pack holds two conflicting values for the same metric and period; understand/auto.json already uses the wrong one (FY2025 operating margin -5.997 instead of about -4.06) and prefetch/forensic.json ROIC (-26.6%) is built on it (about -10% with the filing value).
critical.where: gather/_prefetch.json facts pf_operating_income_fy2025, pf_operating_income_fy2024, pf_operating_income_q_2026_06_30 (vs gather/numbers.json nm_operating_income_*); understand/auto.json history; prefetch/forensic.json roic_last
critical.fix: Drop or supersede the three pf_operating_income_* facts so only nm_operating_income_* reach the pack; rerun ticker-value so history margins, forensic ROIC and any base-year margin use -287.7M (FY2025), -242.8M (FY2024), -297.6M (Q2 2026, incl. the 125.9M BB7 involuntary-conversion loss, a one-off).

critical.finding: dataqa is blocked on cash_and_liquid_investments because the pack adds companyfacts ShortTermInvestments 2,300,000k (2026-06-30) on top of cash 2,288,253k = 4,588,253k. The 10-Q (reading/10q_2026-08-10.txt line ~2992) says the ~2.3B (2.0B at 2025-12-31) is the money-market part of cash equivalents, so the tag sits inside cash. The balance sheet has no short-term investments line. That is about 2.3B (~5.9 USD/share) of phantom liquidity. The redteam cash_reconciles check passed only because it compares the model with the same double-counted figure. Because dataqa is blocked, the engine cannot draw a price conclusion.
critical.fix: Drop or zero the pf_short_term_investments_* facts, citing pf_10q_20260810 (cash equivalents note), or add a qa resolution that cites that note. Spendable cash is 2,288.3M; restricted cash of 434.6M stays excluded. Rerun ticker-value.

critical.finding: No valuation was executed: fc.status = method_not_supported_by_forecast ('cash-cost ratio outside driver bounds'), val not_computed, company_path not_available ('no executed operating or residual-income valuation'). The position part supplied company_path (economics scenarios using IRDM ROIC) and drivers, but none of it ran. Yet value.json says ran=true with every stage 'ok' and no stage_errors. The table shows only 'no reliable value yet' and has no bear/base/bull path, which does not meet the required annual valuation output. A fix to the cash data alone will not unblock it.
critical.where: value.json ran/stages/stage_errors; casefile fc.status/fc.reason, val, company_path; position.json company_path
critical.fix: Repair: give the forecast a form it can run for a pre-revenue builder. Options: a driver spec / econ_case that starts from the guided FY2026 revenue and treats current losses as build-phase cost, or an engine_options/forecast method that accepts operating loss above 100% of revenue. Then rerun ticker-value so company_path executes. Until then, list fc/val not_computed in stage_errors (ran should not read as a valued result) and deliver as a draft with no value.

critical.finding: No valuation was executed, so the table has no fair value or scenario prices and none of the three scenario stories has been priced. Blocker 1 is a data error that the engine read correctly as a conflict: dataqa cash_and_liquid_investments = 4,588.3M = cash 2,288.3M + 'short_term_investments' 2,300.0M. The 10-Q of 2026-08-10 (reading/10q_2026-08-10.txt, fair-value note near line 2992) says the ~$2.3B is money-market cash equivalents INSIDE cash and cash equivalents, so it is counted twice. Spendable cash is 2,288.3M; the 434.6M of restricted cash (UBS loan collateral 428.4M plus 6.2M) stays out. The analyst flagged this double count in position.json gaps[0] and understand/business.json flags.
critical.where: companies/ASTS/out/casefile.json qa.fields.cash_and_liquid_investments (status conflict, blocking) and rv.mechanical.dataqa_blocking; source fact pf_short_term_investments (companyfacts CashEquivalents tag mapped as short-term investments)
critical.fix: Repair: set an inputs override of cash_and_liquid_investments = 2,288,253,000 at 2026-06-30 with short_term_investments = 0, citing nm_cash_q_2026_06_30 and pf_10q_20260810 (the cash-equivalents note), then rerun ticker-value.

critical.finding: Blocker 2, separate from the cash error: the forecast is method_not_supported_by_forecast, 'cash-cost ratio outside driver bounds (operating losses above 100% of revenue)'. The FY2025 operating margin is -400% to -600%, so even with the cash fixed the scenario_survival_fcff path will not build. Contributing data error: auto.json and the prefetch use pf_operating_income_fy2025 = -425.3M, but the 10-K gives -287.7M (revenue 70.9M less opex 358.6M; nm_operating_income_fy2025). That puts the history margin at -5.997 instead of about -4.06.
critical.where: casefile.json fc.status / fc.reason and val.status; understand/auto.json history operating margin FY2025; pf_operating_income_fy2025
critical.fix: Repair: override FY2025 operating income to -287.7M (nm_operating_income_fy2025). Then start the forecast from a pre-service build path (the current_year_revenue guidance of 150-200M with the guided opex of ~100M a quarter plus SBC) using the engine's start-up / pre-revenue route if one exists. If no supported route exists, the result stays a visible draft with no price. Do not loosen the bounds by inventing margins.
